# Emerald Publishing

> A global academic publisher committed to advancing research, responsible management, and the UN Sustainable Development Goals through open access and quality scholarship.

Emerald Publishing is a leading digital-first research publisher specializing in social sciences, management, education, and sustainable development. The organization operates multiple peer-reviewed journals and actively campaigns for research accessibility and responsible publishing practices through initiatives like #DefendResearch.

## Key Topics

- UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)
- Responsible Management
- Academic Publishing
- Research Mission
- Social Sciences
- Quality Education
- Sustainable Infrastructure
- Journal Submissions
- Special Issues
- Calls for Papers
- Autism Research
- Learning Disability Studies
- Information Management
- #DefendResearch Campaign
- Digital-First Publishing

## Core Publishing

- [We are a global publisher](https://emeraldgrouppublishing.com): Emerald Publishing homepage showcasing digital-first research and SDG-aligned mission
- [Calls for Papers](https://www.emeraldgrouppublishing.com/publish-with-us/calls-for-papers): Active calls for papers and special issues across Emerald journals and publications
